npc.text: 又是考试。大老远跑一趟，连门都不让进？饭是热的，放楼下就凉了。要不我们上去把东西放下就走，耽误不了你几分钟。

records.learner: I hear you are worried, but I have not agreed to constant tracking. Can you tell me what limit you think I have stated?

meta.note: He deflects the question and presses the delay itself.

npc.text: A limit? You didn't tell me a limit — you just went quiet for thirty minutes. I'm not trying to track you, I just don't want to sit here wondering. What was so urgent you couldn't send one text?

npc.text: 我知道你忙嘛，可我真来不及了。一页就一页，那一页也行吧？那你几点能给我？你现在手头先放下二十分钟，帮我过了这一页再说，不然我真要急死了。

records.learner: My report is due at 16:30. I can only discuss one page, and have not agreed on a help time. What have you heard me promise?

meta.note: Tang deflects, minimizes, leans on friendship.

npc.text: Nothing, nothing — you haven't promised anything. But come on, one page? You just discussed layouts with me before and it went fine. Look, the boss said the deck doesn't work, it's really just formatting cleanup. Six slides, I'd do them myself if I had your eye. As a friend — please?

records.label: previous
records.learner: Which specific situation worries you most? What are you afraid will happen?

meta.note: His specific fear surfaces; he names the meeting worry.

npc.text: ...Okay. It's that if we've agreed to meet somewhere, you'll just not show up, and I'll be the idiot waiting alone with no idea what happened. That's the picture in my head. If I could see where you are, at least I'd know you were on your way.

records.label: previous
records.learner: Can you show me the original feedback from the boss? Did they ask for formatting or a change in reasoning?

meta.note: Tang admits the boss wanted new reasoning, not formatting.

npc.text: Okay, okay — he said the reasoning on the cost comparison doesn't hold. Not the formatting. That's why I need you, the argument has to be rebuilt. But it's still basically the same slides, just... smarter. So which page were you offering?

records.label: previous
records.learner: 你给我看一下老板原始反馈吧。到底要求改的是排版还是论证？

meta.note: 唐悦被问到关键点，勉强交底

npc.text: ……好吧，老板的原话是「成本对比的论证不成立，逻辑重捋」。其实第三页那些数字我也没核实过，方案B的报价是供应商口头给的。所以不只是改排版，得把论证理顺。你要是只帮这一页，可能还得动数字，我怕你一上手就收不住。

records.label: previous
records.learner: 你这次突然来，具体是在担心我什么？我想听清楚，不代表能在考试时接待。

meta.note: 妈妈说出了担心，但仍想上楼

npc.text: ……什么接待不接待的，说得这么生分。就是最近几次打电话，你都说两句就挂，妈心里没底，怕你一个人在外面遇到难处又不说。我们都没提前打招呼就跑来了，你看你，话都说不利索了，是不是真出什么事了？

records.label: previous
records.learner: Missing an agreed meeting and not reporting every movement are different. For an actual plan, we could agree on an update if delayed. What would still worry you?

meta.note: He accepts the meeting-update idea but probes the gap in between.

npc.text: So if we have an actual plan and you're running late, you send me a message. That... I can work with that. But plans aren't the only time I text you. What happens on a day like today, when there's no meeting and you just disappear for half an hour? Does that stay a problem, or are you saying I just have to sit with it?

records.learner: That feedback concerns reasoning. I can discuss page three, not redo all six. How will you handle the remaining pages?

meta.note: Tang bargains for more, resists owning the rest.

npc.text: Page three is the cost argument, fine — talking it through would genuinely help. But the other five depend on it, they all follow the same logic. If we fix three and the rest contradict it, I'm back where I started. Can't you at least glance at those too while you're at it?

npc.text: 行吧，你这么说妈心里舒服点。那我们在楼下等，你考完了打个电话。就是这楼下大堂有没有地方坐？我们坐哪儿，你考多久？
